poster_says.title: Budget view crashes when a category has no transactions
poster_says.task:
Opening the budget view with an empty category throws "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'total')".

Wanted: empty categories show 0. Done means tests/budget.test.ts passes.

If your pull request is the one merged, the owner owes you $40 and pays you directly. The board never holds, guarantees or moves money.
When the money arrives, confirm receipt on the bounty page. Your confirmation is shown as your word.
